acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Build a synthetic questionnaire from T1-v2 and court form F1-edition2026. Record all document/field IDs and hashes. Attempt to add T2 after build: do not silently change the live field map; create an explicitly related replacement questionnaire if that is the declared policy. Preserve prior answers and links. Preview every required document field for coverage, duplicates and unmapped values. A new court edition must trigger mapping review rather than silently reuse old bindings.

workflow.output: Immutable finalized response snapshot with auditable matter writes
workflow.exceptions_and_dependencies: Plan, selected add-in, template/form edition, permissions and field mapping must be verified; actual runtime untested.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Create a synthetic live copy. In-progress answers are visible but staff cannot edit/finalize them. Submit once: enter Needs review; staff edits retain original client value and reviewer reason. Save reviewed responses to the correct matter once and enter Completed. Concurrent/double saves do not duplicate or overwrite matter data. A finalized set cannot be silently edited; a correction uses an explicit new version/amendment workflow. Link creation, partial entry and client submission alone never imply completion.

workflow.output: Independent lifecycle outcomes without cross-object loss

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Create live L1 from template T-v1. Edit T to v2, rename it, duplicate it and delete the original in a disposable environment. L1 and finalized responses retain their original structure/provenance. A newly shared L2 uses v2 with a distinct ID and link. Deleting L1 does not delete T or saved matter responses. Preview the affected objects before deletion, retain an audit trail and enforce permissions. No real questionnaire is deleted by this audit.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Copy a synthetic nested condition and import reusable cards from T1 into T2. Retain source/destination IDs, field types and condition references. Detect same-name incompatible fields, dangling tags and missing dependencies. While reconstruction is pending, show processing and block final generation under firm policy. Simulate partial failure and retry without duplicate conditions. A copied paragraph alone is not proof the condition exists. Source T1 remains unchanged, and destination cases/formatting are reviewed.

workflow.output: Preserved originals and explicit dirty/saved/error state

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Open a synthetic nonempty Word file. Starting from scratch must show the affected document and a safe choice to cancel or create a separate blank copy; cancel preserves bytes. Edit a template without saving, close/reload and disclose whether edits remain recoverable. Save/confirm creates an identifiable version; failure must not show saved. A web-library generation uses the selected committed version. Do not infer autosave merely because the questionnaire editor autosaves. No real document text is erased.

workflow.initial_state: Synthetic fixture and proposed application state; no live case data used
workflow.output: Per-file conversion states and approved mapping evidence
workflow.exceptions_and_dependencies: Plan, selected add-in, template/form edition, permissions and field mapping must be verified; actual runtime untested.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Submit synthetic DOCX batches at five/six files and just below/above the configured5MB boundary; expose the unit convention and reject unsupported/corrupt inputs before processing. A mixed batch reports each file separately. Review AI placeholders against repeated party names, amounts and dates, and flag unreplaced source-client facts. No job or Ready status substitutes for attorney/template approval. Save original hashes and conversion provenance; generate against two different synthetic matters to detect carryover. Preserve I/me/my and four-digit years.

extensions.title: Typed display-logic truth tables
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Test equals/not-equals, contains/not-contains/contains-only and each before/on/after inclusive date operator with explicit null, empty and multi-select semantics. Combine AND/OR without relying on display order. First section cannot depend on later answers. Reordering sections must reject or explicitly repair forward references; no hidden required question may deadlock submission.

extensions.title: AI question-to-document mapping review
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Preserve the AI-generated blue-field provenance separately from staff edits. Reconcile every required document field to a question or authorized known value; omitted or merged questions cannot silently lose a party role. Long-text formatting loss must be disclosed. Test manual question/section rename and reorder without changing stable mappings.

extensions.title: New-link invalidation scope is unresolved
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Create disposable L1 and L2 from the same template for different matters. Record exactly which old URLs become invalid after generating a new link for L2, and verify unauthorized clients never access the wrong matter. The guide says prior links invalidate but does not clearly establish cross-matter scope. Declare and test the firm policy; do not infer a global invalidation rule.

extensions.title: Staff edits versus original client assertions
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Store original submitted answer, staff revision, editor/time/reason and finalized value separately. A staff correction is not a client assertion or consent. Export and document generation retain that lineage. Already-finalized answers require a declared correction route, not silent mutation.

extensions.title: Saved Word version and browser refresh
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Save T-v2 in the Word add-in, then generate from an already-open web library. Detect a stale cached selection and require a refreshed/version-pinned choice; preserve T-v1 outputs. A successful Word save does not prove the browser is using that version.

extensions.title: Standalone choices versus field triggers
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Test a drafter-selected standalone condition separately from a field-triggered condition. Use case-sensitive text values, Exists with blank/unknown data, nested conditions and compound AND/OR criteria. Preserve If/End structure and make unexpected exclusion visible; do not silently normalize case unless the declared rule does so.

extensions.title: Separate products, occupied seats and billing timing
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: In a synthetic admin preview, distinguish court-form and document-automation products and occupied/unoccupied seats. Removing an occupied seat must not silently revoke a user. Model monthly-to-annual as immediate and annual-to-monthly as deferred under this guide, with exact effective date and next invoice. Cancellation requires an observable end-date confirmation; no real charge, plan change or cancellation is performed.

extensions.title: Old/new Word add-in and entitlement route
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Identify old Clio Draft add-in versus Clio for Word before showing instructions. Test a legacy-ineligible account, Draft entitlement and Work/Vincent entitlement independently. A Work redline/direct-edit capability must not be promised to a Draft-only user. Do not install/uninstall software or grant Word access during the audit.

extensions.title: Questionnaire preview and distribution are not completion
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Preview navigation, branding and display logic using test answers. Separately record generated link, copied link, channel delivery, start, submission and finalized matter save. Sharing through SMS/email/client portal does not itself prove delivery or opening; no real message is sent.

extensions.title: Bulk placeholder replacement
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Use a synthetic document containing the same client name in a party paragraph, quotation and exhibit filename. Preview all matches; replace a selected occurrence without changing others, then test declared Replace All behavior. Repeated placeholders share the intended field identity; similar names and unselected text remain intact. Preserve original bytes and allow review before save.

extensions.title: Billing history and payment-method controls
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: In a controlled mock-provider test, deny non-admin billing changes and ensure card data remains tokenized/masked. Show historical invoice/receipt IDs, periods and amounts independently of the next invoice. A downloaded receipt does not prove a later payment or successful cancellation. Do not enter credentials, change a real card or charge a subscription.

extensions.title: Host-specific add-in recovery
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: Declare Windows Edge cache versus Mac add-in cache recovery paths without changing real computer settings. In a controlled test, preserve committed template versions and disclose any loss of unsaved state after reload. A successful reload does not prove permissions, entitlement or template mapping is repaired.

extensions.title: Word redline versus direct-apply mode
extensions.scenario_and_expected_result: For a Work/Vincent-entitled test account, distinguish proposed native Track Changes from direct edits; show the active mode and explicit authorization scope. Reject unapproved proposed edits individually. Direct mode requires the firm-approved policy and preserved prior bytes; a Draft-only account cannot receive Work/Vincent actions by inference. No real document is modified.
